title: FOMC IFVG lives or dies on the SMT

hero.caption: profit factor on the FOMC IFVG when NQ and ES split (the SMT). 26 events, 35% win rate, **+241 pts** net over 10 years. Drop the divergence filter and the same setup bleeds on a 9-event read. The split is the trade.

useIt: I don't touch the FOMC IFVG without the SMT. Price has to sweep a side on the release, then I need NQ printing a high or low that ES doesn't confirm — that's the divergence. The gap inverts, I enter on the IFVG, stop past the sweep wick. No split between the two, I sit on my hands: the data says it's a money-loser without it.
